name: Mangalore Coastal Belt
significance: Ancient Alupa capital, confluence of Netravati and Phalguni rivers, home to Kadri, Mangaladevi, and Kudroli.
ecologicalContext: Estuarine coastal delta and red laterite ridges

name: Kadri Hills
significance: 10th-century confluence of Natha pantha Buddhist-Shaiva hermitage and perennial natural hill springs.
ecologicalContext: Laterite hills with 9 sacred natural tanks (Gomukha teertha)

name: Kateel Island
significance: Riverine island shrine situated in the exact center of the sacred Nandini river.
ecologicalContext: Perennial river island surrounded by sacred river waters and groves

name: Polali Plain
significance: 8th-century clay idol shrine on the banks of Phalguni river, site of historic Chendu football rites.
ecologicalContext: Lush alluvial floodplains of the Phalguni river

name: Padubidri Grove
significance: Dense sacred serpent grove sanctuary and epicenter of biennial Dakkebali Tantric rites.
ecologicalContext: Pristine coastal evergreen Nagabana ecosystem

name: Barkur Historical Basin
significance: Ancient capital of the Alupa maritime kingdom, home to 365 historic temples and coastal trade canals.
ecologicalContext: Seetha river estuary and ancient port canals

name: Kukke Valley
significance: Deep rainforest valley at the base of the sacred Kumara Parvatha peak, foremost serpent expiation center.
ecologicalContext: Dense tropical rainforest and perennial Kumaradhara river basin

name: Enmoor Garodi
significance: Sacred battlefield and memorial shrine of folk martial heroes Koti and Chennaya.
ecologicalContext: Interior agricultural fields and sacred Garodi precinct

name: Kuttar Foothill
significance: Epicenter of the Koragajja subaltern spirit veneration grove.
ecologicalContext: Laterite hillock shaded by sacred trees

name: Kavathar Alade
significance: Hallowed grove for the mass possession trance and oral epic recitation of Princess Siri.
ecologicalContext: Ancient open-air grove shrine (Alade)

name: Gokarna Coastal Promontory
significance: Sacred headland where the Sahyadri mountains plunge into the Arabian Sea, home of the Atmalinga.
ecologicalContext: Rocky promontories, Om Beach, and perennial Koti Theertha reservoir

name: Mandarthi
significance: Celebrated Shakta temple forest grove and epicenter of major Harake Yakshagana melas.
ecologicalContext: Evergreen woodland buffer zone

name: Bappanadu (Mulki)
significance: Historic maritime confluence and sanctuary founded in partnership with Muslim trader Bappa Byari.
ecologicalContext: Shambhavi river delta and Arabian sea estuary

name: Udupi Car Street Quadrangle
significance: Sanctified pilgrim square housing Sri Krishna Matha, Ashta Mathas, and Madhwa Sarovara.
ecologicalContext: Ancient stone-paved urban sacred square

name: Padumale Memorial Grounds
significance: Birthplace of heroes Koti and Chennaya and their mother Deyi Baidethi.
ecologicalContext: Traditional medicinal plant garden (Deyi Baidethi Vana)

name: Malpe Seashore
significance: Natural maritime harbor and guardian shrine of sea protector Bobbariya.
ecologicalContext: Open sandy coastline and basaltic rock islands

name: Ullal Coastal Spit
significance: Historic seat of Queen Abbakka Chowta and maritime spirit shrines.
ecologicalContext: Sand spit between Netravati estuary and open sea

name: Dharmasthala Valley
significance: Confluence of Shaiva, Jain, and Vaishnava worship on the banks of Netravati river.
ecologicalContext: Dense Western Ghats rainforest valley

name: Karkala Granite Ridge
significance: Monolithic Gommateshwara statue (1432 CE), Chaturmukha Basadi, and Venkataramana temple.
ecologicalContext: Monolithic granite outcrops and rock-cut water tanks

name: Venur Riverside
significance: Ajila dynasty capital with 38-foot Gommateshwara monolith beside Gurupura river.
ecologicalContext: Riverine agricultural valley

name: Kollur (Kodachadri Foothills)
significance: Sacred seat of Goddess Mookambika established by Adi Shankara on Souparnika river.
ecologicalContext: High-altitude Sahyadri rainforest and perennial Souparnika river
